description: ROS 2 graph only; on a DDS-only setup use `list_endpoints`. Describe one ROS 2 `topic` (fully qualified, e.g. `/cmd_vel`) as a `TopicInfo`: counts and, in live mode, `publisher_qos` / `subscription_qos` (`reliability`, `durability` where `transient_local` marks a latched topic such as `/tf_static`, `endpoint_count`; a `null` side says why in its `_note`) and `publisher_nodes` / `subscriber_nodes`. **Raises an MCP error** for a malformed or unknown topic, or without a `ros2` CLI. Read-only; no side effects. **Duration**: `ros2` CLI behind the ROS lock, one call at a time; ends within 45 s; `busy` error if the lock is held (retry).

topic.description: Fully qualified ROS 2 topic name starting with `/`, e.g. `/cmd_vel`. Segments are letters, digits and underscores (not starting with a digit); anything else is rejected before reaching the `ros2` CLI.

name: get_topic_info

durability.description: Shared durability of this side, or `mixed`; `transient_local` marks a latched topic such as `/tf_static`.

endpoint_count.description: Endpoints of this side the values were read from.

reliability.description: Reliability shared by the endpoints of this side, or `mixed` when they disagree.

outputSchema.description: Detail of a single ROS2 topic: counts, QoS per side and the nodes on each side.

publisher_nodes.description: Publisher node names (`ros2 topic info --verbose`); empty when unknown.

publisher_qos.description: QoS of the publishers. `None` when it was not read: see `publisher_qos_note`.

publisher_qos_note.description: Why `publisher_qos` is `None`. `None` when it is set.

subscriber_nodes.description: Subscriber node names; empty when unknown.

subscription_qos.description: QoS of the subscriptions. `None` when it was not read: see `subscription_qos_note`.

subscription_qos_note.description: Why `subscription_qos` is `None`. `None` when it is set.

outputSchema.title: TopicInfo

title: Get topic info
